# Synthetic fixtures only

The24 tiny files in synthetic/ were generated by the unchanged accepted test suite during the successful independent private-checkout test. FIXTURE_MANIFEST.tsv gives bytes, SHA and test-group provenance. All identifiers beginning PRJTOY or Synthetic and numeric arrays are fictitious.

The DKI baseline/perturbed prediction examples are hand-constructed numeric matrices from tests/unit/dki.R, not neural model outputs; no training/prediction was run. EPI zero and vote examples intentionally exercise legal zero-result and at-least-two support cases. Expected values are independently asserted by the test source, not accepted merely because a saved output exists. The test runner regenerates its own fixtures and does not require these snapshots to run.

No database credentials, patient metadata, real abundance inputs, models, external-author data or real production predictions are present.
